281 (Currently amended): A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and at least two adhesive layers, the tool comprising first and second layers, a first adhesive layer configured to be cured on the first layer, a second adhesive layer configured to be cured on the second layer, the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer configured to be cured to each other, the tool has a circular shape and includes a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers, a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer, __and wherein the medial section is bonded to the first and second layers during a curing process__.

282 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a metal, __wherein the metal is bonded to the first and second adhesive layers during the curing process__.

283 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 282, wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure, __wherein the honeycomb structure is bonded to the first and second adhesive layers during the curing process__.

284 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 282, wherein the medial section is a composite material, __wherein the composite material is bonded to the first and second adhesive layers during the curing process__.

285 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section, wherein the plurality of cutting segments are also welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring, wherein the weld ring is continuous, __and wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section and the first and second adhesive layers during the curing process__.

286 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, __wherein the weld ring is formed from a material different from the first and second layers__.

287 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, __wherein the weld ring is formed from a material different from the medial section__.

288 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, __wherein the weld ring is formed from a material different from both the first and second layers and the medial section__.

289 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, further comprising a segmented weld ring, __wherein each segment of the weld ring is independently bonded to the medial section__.

290 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, further comprising an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring, wherein the inner ring includes a central opening for accommodating a drive shaft, __and wherein the inner ring is bonded to the medial section during the curing process__.

291 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 290, __wherein the inner ring includes a central opening and is formed from a material different from the medial section__.

293 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, such that the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring, wherein the weld ring is continuous, __and wherein the weld ring is bonded to the first and second adhesive layers during the curing process__.

294 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 293, __wherein the weld ring is formed from a material different from the first and second layers and the medial section__.

295 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 293, further comprising a segmented weld ring, __wherein each segment of the weld ring is independently bonded to the first and second adhesive layers__.
